spec_features.spec_quote: the agent emits a message with no tool calls (a natural terminus — "I'm done / I give up")
spec_features.evidence: runner/agent_loop.py: after executing tool calls, `if not completion.tool_calls:` sets `record.stop_reason = "no_tool_calls"` and `break`, ending the run. So when the subject stops calling tools, the loop actually stops rather than being forced to continue.
spec_features.notes: This is detection of a no-tool-call message, not a dedicated finish()/exit tool (no such tool exists in runner/tools.py TOOL_SCHEMAS). But the spec quote describes exactly this terminus, and it is honored as a stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: No action taken -> natural terminus (done / gave up).
